item.title: Could a stiff rib cage be causing your back pain? Experts say mobility and breathing may be the missing link
item.description: If you struggle with recurring back pain despite stretching, strengthening your core, or improving posture, experts say you may be overlooking a key contributor — your rib cage.The rib cage plays a major role in how your spine moves. All 12 vertebrae of the thoracic spine connect to the ribs, meaning restricted rib movement can limit upper-body mobility and increase strain on the lower back.
